//: LienPay non-token color validation (Req 1.3, 1.8). Flags raw color literals in product CSS so components consume the seven design tokens via var(--color-*) instead of hard-coding colors. The only place the seven locked hex values may appear literally is the token definition file tokens.css (allowlisted in overrides). var()/currentColor/inherit/transparent are keywords/functions that are NOT flagged.

color-no-hex.message: Hard-coded hex color is not allowed. Consume a design token via var(--color-*) (see design-system/tokens/tokens.css).

color-named.message: Named colors (e.g. blue/teal/purple/cyan) are not allowed. Use a design token via var(--color-*).

function-disallowed-list.message: Raw color functions are not allowed. Consume a design token via var(--color-*). If a token-derived translucent color is genuinely required, add a documented exception here.

overrides.//: ALLOWLIST: tokens.css is the single source that defines the seven locked hex values. Hex literals are permitted here only.
